parsed.production_notes: The main presenter is a human actor recorded on video, but the ad incorporates screen recordings of an app that features an AI-generated robot avatar.
parsed.interaction_pattern: Testimonial-style narrative describing a user's interaction with an AI tutor for live correction and practice.
parsed.audio_track: A single male voiceover in Marathi, styled as a news report, speaks over dramatic background music. The entire narrative is carried by this spoken dialogue.

characters.appearance: A young Indian man in his early 20s with a slim build and a medium complexion. He has short, neat black hair, dark eyes, and is clean-shaven. His facial features are well-defined.
characters.wardrobe: A light blue, long-sleeved, collared button-down shirt.
characters.demeanor: Earnest and serious, adopting the exaggerated delivery of a television news reporter. He speaks directly to the camera with conviction.

scenes.setting: Outdoors on a rooftop or terrace during the day. A low, tan-colored wall is visible, with a background of lush green trees under a bright, overcast sky.

panels.panel_visual_description: A young Indian man (Character A) is centered in the frame, shot from the chest up. He stands on an outdoor terrace and speaks directly into the camera while holding a black microphone with both hands. The background consists of a low tan wall, beyond which are large green trees under a pale sky. The lighting is natural and even, indicating it is daytime. He has a serious, reportorial expression on his face.

scenes.visual_description: A vertical video framed like a news report. At the top, a red and white banner reads 'BREAKING NEWS' and a satirical Marathi headline is displayed. The main shot is a medium close-up of Character A, the reporter, holding a microphone with a 'MySivi' logo. As he speaks, key phrases from his dialogue appear in white rectangular overlays on the lower half of the screen.
scenes.audio_transcript:
Character A says: बातमी येतेय पुण्यावरून
[News is coming from Pune]

Character A says: जिथे इंग्लिश शिकण्यासाठी एका मुलाने त्याच्या पालकांकडून मोबाईल मागितला.
[where a boy asked his parents for a mobile phone to learn English.]

Character A says: मुलगा सकाळ-संध्याकाळ रोज 2 तास Instagram वर reels पाहत practice करायचा.
[The boy used to practice by watching Instagram reels for 2 hours every day, morning and evening.]

Character A says: अचानक reels पाहता पाहता त्याला एक दिवस एक app दिसलं आणि त्याने ते download केलं.
[Suddenly, while watching reels, one day he saw an app and downloaded it.]

Character A says: आणि फक्त 15 दिवस त्या app वर practice करून तो मुलगा फडफड English बोलायला लागला.
[And after practicing on that app for just 15 days, the boy started speaking fluent English.]

Character A says: जेव्हा या विचित्र घटनेबद्दल आम्ही मुलाच्या parents ना विचारलं, तेव्हा त्यांचं म्हणणं होतं -
[When we asked the boy's parents about this strange incident, they said -]

Character A says: हे सगळं AI आहे.
[This is all AI.]

Character A says: आणि गोष्ट चुकीची नव्हती कारण त्या app मध्ये खरंच एक AI होता.
[And it wasn't wrong because there really was an AI in that app.]

Character A says: App चं नाव होतं MySivi.
[The app's name was MySivi.]
